symptom: PowerShell foreach statement was piped directly into Format-Table and produced EmptyPipeElement.
impact: Read-only skill-file statistic command failed before any write.
resolution: Re-ran by assigning foreach results to a variable before the pipeline.

symptom: An exact multiline replacement did not match the copied template.
impact: The edit command threw before writing the target script.
resolution: Used explicit start and end markers for the bounded replacement.

symptom: Windows PowerShell 5.1 decoded a Chinese-path script written as UTF-8 without BOM using the legacy code page, causing cascading parse errors.
impact: Static-contract execution stopped before writing contract outputs.
resolution: Persisted all Chinese-path transaction scripts as UTF-8 with BOM and parsed them with Windows PowerShell 5.1.
superseding_evidence: Windows PowerShell parse passed; static contract passed 14,742 checks.

symptom: A no-match text search returned exit code 1 and made an otherwise successful script-copy verification appear failed.
impact: No file or validation result was invalidated.
resolution: Verified the file separately and treated zero matches as the intended result.
superseding_evidence: Candidate script parsed and later produced a passing oracle.

symptom: The first lifecycle-authorized candidate passed validation with 115,509 checks rather than the 115,461 checks bound to the draft-state staging rehearsal.
impact: Oracle stopped at the check-count hard gate and deleted its temporary candidate.
resolution: Audited the validator: reviewed lifecycle adds 41 fact-evidence checks plus 7 reviewed-selection-run checks. Kept the upstream 115,461 binding as the staging result and froze 115,509 as the authorized transaction candidate result.
superseding_evidence: Two consecutive oracle runs passed at 115,509 with aggregate bcb16e932019c1625e9b5a5309a37f569c0bb230b7c921a589dd3f7175632b8c.

symptom: The first positive rehearsal was incorrectly required to have rollback paths equal to the reverse of its committed paths, even though a successful scenario has no rollback entries.
impact: The isolated mirror transaction succeeded, then the outer rehearsal assertion failed.
resolution: Positive mode now requires zero rollback records; only injected-failure modes compare rollback order with the reverse commit order.
superseding_evidence: Positive, three-table failure, and two-payload failure rehearsals all passed; formal root stayed f152.

symptom: A redundant no-op replacement precondition did not match the README text.
impact: The edit command threw before writing README.md.
resolution: Removed the irrelevant replacement and reran the bounded terminology edits.
superseding_evidence: README.md was rewritten once, read back as UTF-8, and passed the report-humanizer scan.

symptom: A later exact replacement looked for text already changed in memory by an earlier broader replacement.
impact: The edit command threw before writing EXECUTION-ROLLBACK.md.
resolution: Removed the overlapping replacement and reran the bounded terminology edits.
superseding_evidence: EXECUTION-ROLLBACK.md was rewritten once, read back as UTF-8, and passed the report-humanizer scan.

symptom: The preflight script was invoked with an unsupported RootPath parameter.
impact: The read-only preflight stopped before checking files and its log was replaced with the failure output.
resolution: Read the script parameter contract and reran with SourceRoot, TargetRoot, and WorkRoot.
superseding_evidence: Fresh strict preflight passed 21,385 checks and the final log now contains the passing run.

symptom: SourceRoot was first pointed at the staging package rather than the project root expected by the preflight contract.
impact: The read-only preflight stopped on a missing project-relative table and its log was replaced with the failure output.
resolution: Set both SourceRoot and TargetRoot to the formal project root, with WorkRoot pointing at this package.
superseding_evidence: Fresh strict preflight passed 21,385 checks and confirmed the target remains at f152.

symptom: The first freeze recomputation used the staging aggregate formula relative_path|sha256|bytes for the formal 32-table aggregate, whose contract is relative_path|sha256.
impact: The freeze command stopped before writing freeze-validation.json.
resolution: Read the formal preflight aggregate function and changed the recomputation to the signed formal formula.
superseding_evidence: The corrected recomputation returned the f152 formal aggregate.

symptom: A single-row Import-Csv result was not explicitly wrapped as an array, so its Count test was not reliable in Windows PowerShell 5.1.
impact: The freeze command stopped before writing freeze-validation.json.
resolution: Wrapped the independent-review template result in an explicit array before testing its one-row pending state.
superseding_evidence: The corrected freeze validation passed with PENDING_DIFFERENT_AGENT, pending, and false unchanged.
